name: io.github.sblattj/whosaid
title: whosaid
description: Local speaker-attributed transcription and meeting search for Apple Silicon. Audio stays on the Mac.

environmentVariables.name: WHOSAID_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the meetings workspace the search tools read

environmentVariables.name: WHOSAID_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool listing: unset or gateway (2 meta-tools + 5 everyday tools; every other tool stays callable via whosaid_call_tool), full, or a group list like gateway,drafts,live
